transits.comment: Tier A gochar lookup: effect of the transiting Sun / Moon by house position (1..12) counted from the user's rashi. Written once, reviewed with an astrologer; the LLM only phrases these tags. Domain weights are -1 / 0 / +1 and sum into the day's strong/neutral/weak statuses.

consult.line: Today's reading is only the start. Want to know what the day is really hinting at?

aries.today_reading: Today, dear Aries, your energy is bright and work moves fast. Finish the task you kept waiting on and the day opens up for you. Keep the heart simple and honest, and skip one impulse buy. The evening turns light and easy with family.
aries.consult_question: Want to know which task will open your whole day?

domain_insights.line: Your stars keep love simple today. Say the one thing someone at home is waiting to hear.
The day favours finishing old work. A senior will quietly notice your speed.
Your stars keep money steady today. Skip one impulse buy after lunch.
The day gives your body good energy. A morning walk will add even more.
Short trips are smooth under today's stars. A new route may save you time.

taurus.today_reading: Today, dear Taurus, slow and steady wins the day, the way you like it. Old efforts at work begin to show quiet results. A small saving made now will feel very good later. Keep meals light and give someone at home your patient ear.
taurus.consult_question: Curious which old effort of yours pays off first?

domain_insights.line: Your stars favour patient listening today. Someone close may open an old feeling tonight.
Your steady work gets quiet support from the stars. Note who repeats your idea today.
The day favours small savings. Check one recurring expense tonight.
Your stars ask for light food and early rest. Listen to your body at sunset.
The stars keep travel slow today. A postponed trip will find a better date.

gemini.today_reading: Today, dear Gemini, your words carry extra charm. One conversation can open a new door, so speak up where it matters. Write your ideas down before noon, one of them is worth keeping. Evening air outdoors will settle your busy head.
gemini.consult_question: Want to know which conversation opens your new door?

domain_insights.line: Your stars keep love light and playful today. One shared joke may open a closed door.
The day favours honest talk at work. Call the person you keep postponing.
Your stars bring useful ideas today. Write them down, one has real value.
Evening air will calm your busy mind. Keep ten minutes away from the phone.
Short trips are lucky today. Someone on the way may carry good news.

cancer.today_reading: Today, dear Cancer, your soft nature is your strength. Quiet careful effort at work beats loud moves, and your gentle answers mean more than you know. Keep money still and stay close to home tonight, it suits the day.
cancer.consult_question: Curious who values your soft words the most today?

domain_insights.line: Your soft words carry the Moon's blessing today. One message may be read many times.
The stars favour quiet careful work today. The right eyes will find it soon.
Your stars ask money to rest today. An urgent offer can wait one more day.
A simple dinner and early sleep will restore you. The morning will feel lighter.
The day favours staying close to home. A short walk may bring a known face.

leo.today_reading: Today, dear Leo, your warmth pulls people towards you. Lead with a full heart at work and respect follows on its own. Watch small spending in the afternoon and do not skip meals. A short evening outing lifts your mood.
leo.consult_question: Want to know who is quietly watching you today?

domain_insights.line: Your warmth shines under today's stars. A small first move will get a big reply.
The stars favour open-hearted leading today. One quiet watcher matters most.
Your stars keep afternoon spending light. Check where the small amounts go.
The day gives good energy if meals stay on time. Dusk tiredness is mostly hunger.
A short evening outing is lucky today. That pending place is closer than you think.

virgo.today_reading: Today, dear Virgo, clarity is your gift. Clear one messy corner early and the whole day opens up. Write the numbers down and the money answer shows itself. In matters of the heart, feel more and measure less.
virgo.consult_question: Curious what that messy corner has been hiding?

domain_insights.line: Your stars ask the heart to lead today. One unplanned kind word will do a lot.
The day favours clearing one messy corner. That pending pile hides something useful.
Your stars reward written accounts today. One skipped column tells the real story.
An after-dinner walk settles the day. Note the thought that visits you there.
The stars keep travel plain today. Still, a short weekend plan may form.

libra.today_reading: Today, dear Libra, balance comes easily to you. Teamwork carries the day, so invite others in and share the credit. One kind gesture will be remembered for long. A quiet evening hour brings your calm back.
libra.consult_question: Want to know who will remember your kindness longest?

domain_insights.line: Your kind gesture carries the stars' favour. Someone is quietly keeping count.
The day favours working with others. The quiet one has the missing idea.
Your stars keep money balanced today. A fair deal may look very ordinary.
A quiet evening hour restores your balance. One returning thought wants a decision.
The stars favour going out with company. The invite you almost decline may be the best part.

scorpio.today_reading: Today, dear Scorpio, your focus runs deep. Pick one goal and give it full effort, the day respects it. Money grows through consistency today, not chasing. Keep journeys short and take real breaks between the push.
scorpio.consult_question: Curious which goal deserves your full push today?

domain_insights.line: Your stars favour a little trust today. What you guard may already be safe here.
The day respects one goal and full effort. The midday distraction is only a test.
Your stars grow money through consistency. The boring option is quietly winning.
Strong drive needs real breaks today. Your shoulders are telling the truth.
The stars keep travel short today. A small delay may be a quiet favour.

sagittarius.today_reading: Today, dear Sagittarius, your spirits fly high. Share your big picture and let one honest comment sharpen it. Travel plans take a real step forward today. Spend on learning and laugh freely in the evening.
sagittarius.consult_question: Want to know when your travel plan finally moves?

domain_insights.line: Honest words carry the stars' blessing tonight. The bond will grow deeper.
The day favours sharing your big picture. One doubt hides a useful clue.
Your stars reward spending on learning. That saved course is relevant again.
Your spirits fly high under today's stars. Note who makes you laugh the most.
Travel plans move forward under today's stars. A stuck date may settle by night.

capricorn.today_reading: Today, dear Capricorn, quiet duty starts paying back. The work you carried without noise is earning respect in rooms you do not see. Choose slow and safe over quick schemes today. Unhurried time at home warms the evening.
capricorn.consult_question: Curious where your name was mentioned today?

domain_insights.line: Your stars warm the home this evening. One small chore will say a lot.
Your quiet duty earns respect under today's stars. Your name comes up where you are not.
The stars favour slow and safe money today. The dull option holds more.
Your stars ask you to stretch between long sittings. Five minutes now saves the evening.
The day favours short errands over long journeys. One nearby stop holds a small surprise.

aquarius.today_reading: Today, dear Aquarius, watching and listening will serve you well. One sentence in a routine talk can be worth the whole day. A shelved idea may be ready to earn now, so open that old note tonight. Keep the late hours quiet.
aquarius.consult_question: Want to know which one sentence matters most today?

domain_insights.line: Your stars grow closeness through listening. Today's words carry a second meaning.
The day asks you to watch and listen. One sentence is worth the whole day.
Your old idea is ready under today's stars. Open that note tonight.
Late quiet time clears the mind. Keep the last half hour screen-free.
The stars ask travel to wait a little. Something is still arranging itself.

pisces.today_reading: Today, dear Pisces, your gentle heart leads the way. A few soft words from you will be enough where others need long speeches. Give your imagination one task and it will surprise you. Music or prayer at dusk leaves you full.
pisces.consult_question: Curious what your calm evening is trying to tell you?

domain_insights.line: Your gentle words carry the Moon's softness. The silence after them says more.
The stars favour your imagination today. Write the simple idea down.
Your stars keep money simple today. Note what you spend, it will show one leak.
Music or prayer at dusk fills the heart. That calm answers today's question.
Known roads are lucky today. One small detail waits to be noticed.
